gates.default: uv run pytest -m "not live and not live_write" && uv run ruff check src/ tests/ && uv run ruff format --check src/ tests/ && uv run mypy src/

interactive_only: Slack app creation / scopes / install (one app per workspace)
user token (xoxp) creation / rotation — never pasted into a session
live smoke against the real workspaces (writes only in the user's own self-DM)
alejlatorre-mcps swap of the two workspace entries + hot deploy with live sessions
first real send as the user (group DM with a teammate) — explicit OK per message

reversibility_triggers.decision: publish to PyPI as `amazing-slack-mcp` (ADR-0001; `slack-mcp` and `slack-mcp-server` are taken)
reversibility_triggers.trigger: the user registers the pending trusted publisher under a different free name
reversibility_triggers.fallback: rename dist + console script in lockstep on main before the first release; import package `slack_mcp` and tool prefix `slack_` never change

reversibility_triggers.decision: ONE identity: a user token (xoxp) from the personal internal app 'Alejandro AI'; the server refuses xoxb/xapp/xoxc/xoxd at settings load. Bots are Hermes' gateway, not this MCP
reversibility_triggers.trigger: a workflow needs a bot identity from THIS server (Hermes cannot cover it)
reversibility_triggers.fallback: accept xoxb behind an explicit SLACK_ALLOW_BOT_TOKEN=1 with the user-only tools (search) failing cleanly; the guard semantics stay

reversibility_triggers.decision: stdio only — no http transport, no ax42 unit, no Funnel path: the token acts as the user and never leaves the machine
reversibility_triggers.trigger: a cloud client (Grok Bot) wants Slack
reversibility_triggers.fallback: NOT this token. A separate bot-token deployment (Data Bot) behind a bearer, as splitwise does; the user token stays local

reversibility_triggers.decision: raw httpx client against https://slack.com/api (JSON bodies where Slack accepts them, form-encoded where it does not — table in research/02), no `slack_sdk` dependency
reversibility_triggers.trigger: a method needs a quirk that costs more than a day to reproduce
reversibility_triggers.fallback: vendor the exact helper from python-slack-sdk (MIT) with attribution; still no SDK dependency

reversibility_triggers.decision: write guard = SLACK_ALLOW_WRITES=1 AND (channel in SLACK_WRITE_CHANNELS, or an IM/MPIM whose OTHER members are all in SLACK_WRITE_USERS); Slack Connect (is_ext_shared/is_shared/is_org_shared/is_pending_ext_shared) refused unless listed by ID; a post is never auto-retried
reversibility_triggers.trigger: the allowlists cost more friction than they buy for a trusted workspace
reversibility_triggers.fallback: a `*` wildcard for SLACK_WRITE_CHANNELS / SLACK_WRITE_USERS that still refuses Slack Connect channels; the switch stays in the package

reversibility_triggers.decision: name → user-ID resolution uses stdlib difflib over a users.list cache, no rapidfuzz dependency
reversibility_triggers.trigger: a live resolve mis-ranks a real teammate or exceeds 200 ms on the real user list
reversibility_triggers.fallback: add `rapidfuzz` as a runtime dependency and swap the scorer in tools/users.py only
